svg.title: Diagram 3. Push-to-talk sequence in Bottle: hotkey, mic lease, VAD, STT, cleanup and classifier in parallel with the RecallGate, then insert or copy (UC1), a 1.5 s preview or an Ask Genie chip (UC2)
svg.desc: UML-style sequence for one push-to-talk utterance. Key-down: R1 sends hotkey.ptt, R2 takes the mic lease and opens the stream, then the mood becomes listening in under 100 ms and the warm-ups start. A hold under 250 ms or another key in the first 1 s cancels. Key-up adds 120 ms post-roll. STT is local Parakeet by default. Databricks ASR runs only when the user selected it, the probe passed and the speech is 300 ms or more (CAP-57c, CAP-57e). A pre-pass shows the raw draft. Cleanup and the classifier run in parallel on the pre-pass text with a 900 ms deadline, and the RecallGate semantic tier runs in parallel with them. Dictation is inserted into the active app without the main agent (UC1). Context shows Copy with concealed clipboard flags and a context memory item. A question goes to the main agent: a memory answer, a 1.5 s preview with Send now, Edit and Cancel at confidence 0.7 or more, or an Ask Genie chip below 0.7. The blurb shows bold numbers and Open in Databricks. Lower panels: hands-free double-tap, STT fallback chain and safeguards, hotkey edge cases and the latency budget.

Sessions: local Parakeet → Databricks ASR (if allowed) → queue. MDM SttPolicy=local_only removes every cloud step (CAP-60).
CAP-54 no ASR call for < 300 ms of speech; silence is trimmed first
CAP-56 hallucination guard: > 6 words per second of speech, or a known
hallucination phrase → local STT for that utterance
CAP-58 rolling p95 > 1.3 s or 3 errors in 10 min → PTT uses local STT;
a notice shows and a re-probe runs after 24 h
CAP-57 first-run probe: 22 requests, p95 ≤ 1.0 s, WER ≤ 10 %;
re-probe every 7 d and on a network change
CAP-64 language not covered by Parakeet → Databricks ASR if allowed,
else "This language is not supported on this device"

Panel D. Latency budget, key-up to chip (p50 / p95, Section 8.1)
0 key-up seen 3 / 10 ms · ack (mood + pill) ≤ 100 ms · 1 post-roll 120 ms · 2 VAD flush 10 / 20 ms
3 STT tail: local 120 / 400 ms, cloud 600 / 1,000 ms · 4 pre-pass 3 / 5 ms · 5 cleanup ∥ classifier 350 / 800 ms (deadline 900)
6 number check 2 / 5 ms · 7 chip render 20 / 40 ms · total local 0.63 / 1.40 s, cloud 1.11 / 2.00 s · NFR-01: 1.5 s / 2.2 s
RecallGate adds ≤ 300 ms before genie_ask and never blocks the UI; a late memory hit shows as a chip (MEM-16).
Diagram 3. Push-to-talk. The mic opens before the
listening mood shows. Dictation never reaches the
agent or Genie. IDs: CAP-04, CAP-12a..c, CAP-35a,
RTR-01b/c, RTR-04a, RTR-05, MEM-16a..e, SEC-30, D69.
Purple pill = Rive mood on the MOG view.
